name: modaliser-companion
description: Answers Modaliser's questions about what is open in this VSCode window, over a Unix-domain socket.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension only reports which editors and terminals this window holds, and activates one of them on request. It never reads workspace content, runs workspace code, or honours workspace settings.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Listing a window’s tabs and terminals needs no local file system.
